# Technical SEO audit: lordevs.com

**Date:** 8 November 2026
**Phase:** 1 (audit) + 2 (report). Read-only. Nothing in the site has been changed for this audit.
**Scope:** the codebase in this repo (static HTML generated by `build.mjs` from `content/*.json`), plus the live domain.

---

## Read this first: the live site is down

`https://lordevs.com` and `https://www.lordevs.com` both return **HTTP 404** with Vercel's `DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND` body. The domain points at Vercel, but no deployment is attached to it. Google can't index anything until this is fixed. Every "live" check below (redirects, headers, Lighthouse, field Core Web Vitals) is therefore marked **not checked** and was done against the code instead.

```
$ curl -sI https://lordevs.com
HTTP/2 404
server: Vercel
strict-transport-security: max-age=63072000

$ curl -s https://lordevs.com
The deployment could not be found on Vercel.
DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND

$ curl -sI http://lordevs.com
HTTP/1.0 308 Permanent Redirect
Location: https://lordevs.com/
```

---

## 1. Top 10 issues by impact

1. **The site isn't deployed.** The domain returns 404 everywhere (see above). Nothing else matters until this is fixed.
2. **It's a one-page site, so there are no pages to rank for the target searches.** Of the target routes, only `/` exists. There are no service pages, portfolio or guides. "web development services", "ecommerce website development" and the cost questions have nowhere to land.
3. **The positioning doesn't match the target keywords.** The title, H1 and service copy are about *branded web design and brand identity*. The words "web development", "ecommerce", "Shopify" and "WooCommerce" barely appear (the only development service listed is "Custom Webflow & Headless Development"). Before any pages are built, you need to decide which of those services you actually sell.
4. **The loading screen delays the main content (LCP).** A full-screen loader covers the page for about 2.3s on every visit, then the headline animates in. Measured locally with **no network or CPU throttling**, the desktop LCP (largest content to appear) was **2,732 ms**, already over the 2.5s target before real-world conditions.
5. **Images are much heavier than needed.** About 600 KB of the 945 KB page is images. The four avatar PNGs weigh 39, 163, 217 and 156 KB but display at 42×42 px, and they load twice (hero and About tile). The client logos are full-size PNGs. WebP at the display size would bring all of this under about 40 KB.
6. **There's no `robots.txt` or `sitemap.xml`.** Neither exists in the repo, and both 404 on the domain.
7. **Private and source files would be published.** Vercel deploys the repo root, so `content/.backups/*.json`, `content/*.json`, `admin/`, `dev.mjs`, `build.mjs` and this audit would all be publicly reachable. `admin/` is `noindex`, but the rest isn't. A `.vercelignore` (or a `dist/` output folder) would fix it.
8. **There's no social-share image or Twitter tags.** `og:image`, `twitter:card` and related tags are missing, so links shared on LinkedIn, WhatsApp or X show no preview image.
9. **The structured data is thin.** The `Organization` JSON-LD has no `sameAs` (Fiverr, LinkedIn, GitHub, Clutch), no `contactPoint` and no `WebSite` entity. The `FAQPage` markup is valid but no longer earns rich results for an agency site, so it's harmless but has no effect.
10. **There's no measurement.** The site has no analytics or conversion tracking (Calendly bookings, WhatsApp clicks, email clicks), even though a cookie-consent banner exists. Search Console and Bing aren't verified, because the site isn't live.

Also important for trust (E-E-A-T, Google's experience-and-trust signals), though not strictly technical: several on-page claims and names look like **template placeholders**. "230+ websites", "98% satisfaction", "4X brand value", "35+ countries", "100+ iconic brands", a "4.9" rating, the project names in the work strip (Apex Logistics, Northwind Media, SolarPeak, Bright Dental, Nova Legal) and the "Trusted by" logos in the comparison section (ZenZap, sparkle, innovio, Craftgram, LumLabs) all need confirming. If they aren't real, they should be replaced or removed. The brief's rule against inventing clients and results applies to existing copy too.

## 2. Full findings

Impact: H/M/L. Effort: S (under 1h), M (half a day), L (a day or more).

| # | Issue | Evidence | Impact | Effort | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Crawlability & indexing** |
| 1 | No deployment on the domain | `curl https://lordevs.com` returns `404 DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND` | H | S | Redeploy the project on Vercel and attach `lordevs.com` + `www`. Needs your Vercel access, so you do this or I guide you. |
| 2 | No `robots.txt` | Not in the repo; 404 live | H | S | Have the build generate it: allow all, reference the sitemap, disallow `/admin/` and `/content/`. |
| 3 | No canonical-host redirect confirmed | `www` also returns 404; can't test while undeployed | M | S | In Vercel Domains, set `lordevs.com` as primary and `www` to 308-redirect to it. http→https already redirects (308, verified). |
| 4 | No custom 404 page | Vercel's default would be served | L | S | Add `404.html`; Vercel serves it automatically with a real 404 status. |
| 5 | Admin and source files publicly deployable | `admin/`, `content/.backups/`, `dev.mjs`, `build.mjs` in the deploy root | M | S | Build into `dist/` (or add `.vercelignore`) so only the site files are deployed. |
| 6 | `.html` URLs and inconsistent slash handling | Footer links to `privacy.html`; canonical is `https://lordevs.com/privacy.html` | L | S | Turn on `cleanUrls` and `trailingSlash` in `vercel.json` and update the canonicals to match. Only matters before launch, so there's no 301 plan to worry about. |
| **Canonicals & duplicates** |
| 7 | Canonicals present and self-referencing | `build.mjs:476`: `https://lordevs.com/` and `/privacy.html` | Pass | – | Keep. Update them if clean URLs are adopted (#6). |
| 8 | No parameter or duplicate-content risk | Two pages, no query routes | N/A | – | – |
| **XML sitemap** |
| 9 | No sitemap | Not in the repo | H | S | Generate `sitemap.xml` in `build.mjs` from the page list. Use each content JSON's git commit date for `<lastmod>`, not the build time. |
| **Rendering & HTML basics** |
| 10 | All content is in the HTML source | `index.html` is static, and the headings, copy and FAQ are in source | Pass | – | – |
| 11 | Exactly one `<h1>`, logical H2/H3 order | 1× h1 ("Websites that turn your business into the obvious choice"), then h2/h3 | Pass (minor) | S | Optional: work the main intent into the H1 or an eyebrow line, e.g. "web design & development". The footer uses `<h4>` with no h2/h3 before it, which is cosmetic. |
| 12 | Title doesn't target the main search intent | `<title>Branded Web Design & Brand Identity Agency – Lordevs</title>` (52 chars) | M | S | Decide on positioning first (top issue 3). A suggestion: "Web Design & Development Agency – Lordevs". |
| 13 | Meta description too long | 174 chars, so it gets cut off in results | L | S | Rewrite at about 150 characters. |
| 14 | `lang`, charset and viewport present | `build.mjs:493-494, 534` | Pass | – | – |
| 15 | Internal links are real `<a href>` | All nav and footer links are anchors | Pass | – | Nav items are all `#section` anchors, so once real pages exist the nav should link to them. |
| **Core Web Vitals & performance** |
| 16 | Loader delays LCP | Local desktop LCP **2,732 ms** unthrottled (element: `.t-dark` in the h1). The loader runs about 2.3s by design (`script.js` loaderTl) | H | S | Remove the loader, or limit it to about 300 ms and only on the first visit, and show the h1 without waiting for the animation. This is a design change, so I'll ask first. |
| 17 | Oversized avatar PNGs | `assets/avatar-1..4.png` = 39/163/217/156 KB shown at 42 px | H | S | Resize to 84×84 (for 2× screens) and save as WebP, about 3 KB each. |
| 18 | Client logos are full-size PNGs with no width/height | `assets/logo-*.png` (Brilliant AI 72 KB); `<img>` without width/height (layout-shift risk in the above-the-fold logo row) | M | S | Resize, convert to WebP or SVG, and add `width`/`height`. |
| 19 | Heavy third-party JS loaded up front | three.js r128 (118 KB transferred), GSAP + ScrollTrigger, and Calendly `widget.js` plus a 700 px iframe that loads on page load even though it sits near the bottom | M | M | Load Calendly only when the booking section approaches. Add `defer` to scripts. Consider whether the Three.js scenes are worth their cost on mobile. |
| 20 | Google Fonts from a third party | `fonts.googleapis.com` with `display=swap` | L | S | OK as is. Self-hosting Quicksand would remove 2 extra server connections. |
| 21 | No long-cache headers for assets | Vercel default `max-age=0, must-revalidate`; files not hashed | L | S | `vercel.json` headers: long cache for `/assets/*`, plus versioned CSS/JS filenames. |
| 22 | Text compression | Vercel serves Brotli by default | Pass (expected) | – | Verify once deployed. |
| **Mobile & accessibility** |
| 23 | Mobile page is wider than the screen | On a 360 px phone the layout viewport is **408 px** (visual 360), so the page pans sideways by 48 px | M | S | Find and fix the element wider than the screen. Suspects: the 106vw industry band, or Calendly's `min-width:320px` plus padding. |
| 24 | Image alt text | Logos have alt (brand names); avatars are decorative with `alt=""` | Pass | – | – |
| 25 | Tap targets, contrast, focus | Not measured | – | – | Run Lighthouse mobile once deployed. |

| 26 | Organization is minimal; no WebSite | `build.mjs:478-483`: name, url, logo, email, telephone only | M | S | Add `sameAs` (Fiverr, LinkedIn, GitHub, Clutch: please send URLs), a `contactPoint`, and a `WebSite` entity. Use `ProfessionalService` only if you publish an address. |

| 28 | No self-serving review markup | Testimonials aren't marked up | Pass | – | Keep it that way. |

| 32 | HTTPS + HSTS | `strict-transport-security: max-age=63072000` (Vercel) | Pass | – | – |

| 34 | No terms page; no address | Footer has Privacy only | L | S | Add a terms page. An address is optional (needed only for `ProfessionalService` and local SEO). |

| 36 | No `og:image` / Twitter card | `build.mjs:499-503` | M | S | Create a 1200×630 share image and add `og:image`, `twitter:card=summary_large_image` and related tags to every page. |
| 37 | File names | `avatar-1.png`, `logo-dotcode.png` | L | S | Fine for decorative images. Use descriptive names for case-study images. |

| 38 | Single language, `lang="en"`, no hreflang | – | Pass | – | – |

## 4. What I couldn't check, and why

- **Everything live** (redirect chains, `www`→apex, real response headers, compression, soft-404 behaviour, Lighthouse, PageSpeed field data): the deployment is missing.
- **Lighthouse scores**: Lighthouse isn't installed locally, and I didn't install it without asking. I can run it locally with `npx lighthouse` if you approve the install, or against the live URL once it's deployed.
- **Google Search Console / Bing data, Google Business Profile and directory listings (Name/Address/Phone consistency)**: no access.
- **Rich Results Test**: this needs a public URL.

---

## Questions I need answered before phase 3

1. **Positioning:** should the site target *web development* (ecommerce stores, business websites) as the brief says, *branded web design / brand identity* as the current copy says, or both? This decides the title, the H1 and which service pages get built.
2. **Services actually offered:** ecommerce development? Shopify? WooCommerce? Website redesign? (The brief says to create the Shopify and WooCommerce pages only if you offer them.)
3. **Homepage as services hub:** I recommend `/` stays the services hub and no separate `/web-development-services/` page is created. OK?
4. **Stats, project names and logos:** which of the numbers and names in the trust note are real?
5. **Profiles for `sameAs`:** your Fiverr, LinkedIn, GitHub and Clutch URLs.
6. **Loader:** may I remove the loading screen or shorten it to about 300 ms? This changes the design, so I'm asking first.
7. **Vercel:** will you redeploy and attach the domain, or do you want step-by-step help? Should the build output go to `dist/` so the admin and source files aren't published?

## Note on the architecture work (phase 3)

The generator writes flat files to the repo root and every asset path is relative (`styles.css`, `assets/...`). Pages at `/ecommerce-website-development/` need: root-absolute asset paths (`/styles.css`), folder output (`slug/index.html`), canonicals without `index.html`, a breadcrumb section, a page-level JSON-LD hook, and nav links that point to real pages instead of only `#anchors`. That's a medium-sized change to `build.mjs`, separate from writing the pages themselves. The page copy would be clearly marked `TODO: content`, with no invented prices or results.
